description: A new simulation suggests sulfur in star-forming clouds may be locked inside icy dust grains through previously overlooked chemical reactions. The findings offer fresh clues to a decades-old cosmic mystery and could improve our understanding of life's essential ingredients in space.
title: Scientists May Have Solved the Missing Sulfur Mystery in Star-Forming Clouds

description: The US Government Accountability Office has urged the FDIC to improve coordination with other regulators on blockchain-related risks. The recommendation comes as stablecoin oversight expands under the GENIUS Act and blockchain-based financial products continue to grow.
title: US Regulator Urges FDIC for Better Coordination on Crypto, Blockchain Risks

description: Huawei could be working on a new vertical trifold handset, as the smartphone maker has seemingly filed a patent application for the design of the same in the US. The foldable is shown to feature two horizontally placed hinges, which might allow the smartphone to fold vertically into an S-shaped design. Huawei’s patent application also shows that its vertical twice-folding handset will fold into a relatively smaller flip phone, which might have a smaller horizontal footprint than the company’s Huawei Pura X flip handset. The hinges divide the internals into three different compartments.
title: Huawei Patent Document Describes 'Vertical' Trifold Smartphone With Two Hinges

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 reportedly received certification from the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC). The listing indicates the model number and connectivity details of the foldable. It is likely to come with a Snapdragon chipset. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is likely to launch next month alongside the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Galaxy Z Flip 8. It could come with satellite connectivity.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Listed on US FCC Database With Snapdragon Chipset

description: Pudgy Penguins has announced the closure of Pudgy Party, its mobile game launched in 2025. The NFT project said future gaming development will be focused on Pudgy World, its web-based platform, as the broader Web3 gaming sector continues to grapple with monetisation and sustainability challenges.
title: Pudgy Penguins to Discontinue 'Pudgy Party' Mobile Game in Favour of New Web Based Game

description: Meta has announced new AI-powered features for Facebook, led by the introduction of AI Mode, a search experience that generates answers using publicly available content from Facebook Groups, Reels and other Meta services. The update also adds AI-assisted creative tools, including collage templates, video montage effects and camera roll-based sharing suggestions. Users will also gain access to AI-powered photo presets that can modify clothing, hairstyles and accessories. Meta said camera roll suggestions remain optional and can be turned off at any time.
title: Meta Introduces AI Mode on Facebook With AI-Powered Search for Public Posts, Reels

description: Oppo Reno 16, Reno 16 Pro, and Reno 16F have been spotted on the EU’s European Product Registry for Energy Labelling (EPREL) certification database with the model numbers CPH2865, CPH2863, and CPH2859, respectively. The Oppo Reno 16 and Oppo Reno 16 Pro are listed on the website with a 5,820mAh battery, while the Oppo Reno 16F appears with a 6,325mAh cell. While the standard Oppo Reno 16 model appears with battery endurance per cycle of 63 hours and 9 minutes, the Pro model is listed with 62 hours of battery endurance per cycle. On the other hand, the Oppo Reno 16F has the longest 75 hours of battery endurance per cycle.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Series Key Features Revealed via European Certifications Ahead of Global Debut

description: Commodore was an iconic computing and electronics name in the 1980s. The brand originally became famous for launching the personal computer revolution. In the decades that followed, the company encountered financial hurdles and ultimately ceased all manufacturing, while also licensing its name for a few unsuccessful Android phones in 2015. It has now returned with an unexpected new product in the form of Callback 8020, a retro-inspired flip phone designed as a digital detox device.
title: Commodore Callback 8020 Flip Phone With Sailfish OS Unveiled as 'Digital Detox' Smartphone

description: WhatsApp is said to be preparing a new privacy feature that would allow users to send text messages that disappear after being viewed once. The functionality was spotted in an iOS beta build by WABetaInfo and could be enabled through a new send menu option. The report suggests it will work in private and group chats while limiting actions such as forwarding, copying, screenshotting and screen recording.
title: WhatsApp Said to Be Developing View-Once Text Messages Feature for iOS App

description: Redmi Turbo 5 was launched in India earlier today with a 7,540mAh battery and MediaTek's Dimensity 8500 Ultra chipset. It has 100W wired fast charging and features a dual rear camera unit. The new phone competes with the Motorola Edge 70 Pro and the Samsung Galaxy A37 5G in the mid-range segment. Here's a detailed comparison of the Redmi Turbo 5, Motorola Edge 70 Pro, and Samsung Galaxy A37 5G based on their pricing and key specifications in India.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 vs Motorola Edge 70 Pro vs Samsung Galaxy A37 5G: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: Lenovo Tab Plus Gen 2 launched in global markets with MediaTek Dimensity 7400 processor with up to 12GB of RAM and up to 256GB of storage. It comes with an inbuilt 360-degree rotating kickstand and a nine-speaker JBL-engineered audio system. The tablet has a 12.1-inch display with 2.5K resolution. It features a 10,200mAh battery with support for 45W charging
title: Lenovo Tab Plus Gen 2 Launched With Dimensity 7400 SoC, JBL Speaker System: Price, Specifications

description: Spotify has announced Track Reactions, a new feature for collaborative playlists that lets users respond to songs with emoji reactions. Contributors can choose from six emoji, including a heart, thumbs up and fire, with reactions appearing next to tracks for other collaborators to see. The feature is limited to collaborative playlists and includes notifications when connected users react to songs. Spotify will make Track Reactions available to users aged 16 and older on Free and Premium plans, with a gradual rollout planned in selected markets.
title: Spotify Upgrades Collaborative Playlists Feature With Emoji-Based Reactions for Tracks

description: Athiradi follows a student who revives a tragic college festival, only to become entangled in unexpected action-packed events.
title: Athiradi OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Tovino Thomas’ Malayalam Action-Comedy Online

description: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Edge was launched on Monday. It is the South Korean tech conglomerate’s first laptop powered by Qualcomm’s new Snapdragon X2 Elite platform. The laptop sports a 16-inch WQXGA+ AMOLED screen and comes with quad speakers and Dolby Atmos support. Samsung says the Galaxy Book 6 Edge offers a combination of AI-powered productivity features with deep integration across the Galaxy ecosystem. The laptop is claimed to deliver up to 22 hours of video playback on a single charge.
title: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Edge Launched With Snapdragon X2 Elite Chip, Galaxy AI Features: Price, Specifications

description: Redmi K90 Ultra will be launched in China this month, the Xiaomi sub-brand has confirmed. Along with the launch teaser, the smartphone maker has also opened pre-orders for the upcoming Redmi K90 series handset, available via the Xiaomi China online store. The handset is shown to feature a power button and volume controls on the right side. It will also sport a flat rear panel, with the camera module placed at the top. The phone will succeed the Redmi K80 Ultra, which was launched in June last year with an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9400+ chipset and a 7,410mAh battery.
title: Redmi K90 Ultra Launch Timeline Confirmed, Pre-Orders Open Ahead of China Debut

description: OnePlus 16 could launch soon. Ahead of launch, a leak has suggested the display details of the phone. OnePlus could use a BOE display for this model with a high refresh rate. The OnePlus 16 is expected to run on Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset. It could feature a 6.78-inch 1.5K panel. The bezels could be less than 1mm on all four sides. The phone could offer an 185Hz refresh rate.
title: OnePlus 16 Tipped to Feature BOE Display With 185Hz Refresh Rate, Slim Bezels

description: Ubisoft has detailed the new content coming with Title Update 1.1.11 for Assassin's Creed Shadows. The game's final update will bring a new story quest, projects that crossover with Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, a new endgame feature, and more.
title: Assassin's Creed Shadows' Final Update Adds New Story Quest and Crossover Projects With Black Flag Resynced

description: Dreame L50s Pro Ultra and Dre robotic vacuum cleaners have been launched in India. They offer vacuuming and mopping functions with the company's Vormax suction technology. They support voice inputs through third-party voice assistants and carry a 5,200mAh battery. The accompanying base station offers automatic dust collection, automatic water tank refilling, and automatic detergent dispensing. The Dreame L50s Pro Ultra offers up to 30,000Pa of suction power.
title: Dreame L50s Pro Ultra, Dreame L50 Ultra CE Launched in India With Up to 30,000Pa of Suction Power: Price, Features

description: Drishyam 3 continues Georgekutty’s battle to protect his family as a new investigation threatens to expose long-buried secrets.
title: Drishyam 3 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Mohanlal’s Crime Thriller Online?

description: Vivo T5 Lite 5G could launch in India soon, according to a new leak that reveals key specifications of the handset. The smartphone is tipped to feature a 6.74-inch HD+ 120Hz LCD panel, a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and up to 256GB of storage. It may also pack a 6,500mAh battery with 44W fast charging support. Other expected features include a 50-megapixel rear camera, a 5-megapixel selfie camera, an IP65 rating and two colour options.
title: Vivo T5 Lite 5G Leak Reveals Display, Battery and Camera Details Ahead of Anticipated India Launch

description: A week after Ninja Theory announced Senua, the next game in the Hellblade series, the studio is facing closure. Bloomberg reported Tuesday that the developer, alongside several other studios at Xbox, are at the risk of shutting down. Ninja Theory, Compulsion Games, and Double Fine are said to be in talks with Xbox to spin off.
title: Microsoft Reportedly Shutting Down Hellblade Developer Ninja Theory, Several Other Xbox Studios

description: Sharp Aquos R11 has been launched in Japan as the latest smartphone from Sharp. The latest Sharp Aquos series phone comes in three colourways and runs on the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset along with 12GB RAM. It features a 6.5-inch display with a peak brightness of 3600 nits. The Sharp Aquos R11 has a triple rear camera unit headlined by a 50.3-megapixel main sensor. The Sharp Aquos R11 carries a 5,100mAh battery.
title: Sharp Aquos R11 Launched With Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 Chipset, Three Rear Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: Kenatha Kanom follows a drought-hit village whose search for water leads to the discovery of an ancient dinosaur fossil and unexpected challenges.
title: Kenatha Kanom OTT Release: When and Where to Watch Yogesh Babu’s Satirical Drama Online

description: Redmi Turbo 5 has been launched in India. The smartphone arrives in the country months after its debut in China. It is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra chipset, coupled with a 7,540mAh battery. The new Redmi Turbo series handset also offers 100W wired fast charging. It is set to go on sale in India via Amazon. The phone carries a dual rear camera, headlined by a 50-megapixel main shooter, paired with an 8-megapixel ultrawide camera. The phone also features a 20-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 Launched in India With 7,540mAh Battery, MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra SoC: Price, Specifications

description: The DJI Osmo Pocket 4P was launched on Tuesday. Geared towards content creators and vloggers, it is the China-based company’s latest pocket-sized camera. DJI claims it has a notable upgrade over its predecessor and is designed to deliver professional-grade imaging capabilities in a portable form factor. It features a dual-camera setup featuring a 1-inch wide-angle sensor and a dedicated mid-telephoto camera.
title: DJI Osmo Pocket 4P Launched With Dual Camera Architecture, 3-Axis Gimbal: Price, Specifications

description: Tecno Spark 50 Pro has been unveiled with a MediaTek Helio G100 Ultimate chipset, a 6.78-inch 120Hz display and a 50-megapixel Sony Lytia 600 camera. It is offered with either a 5,600mAh or 6,000mAh battery, both supporting 60W fast charging. The handset also carries IP68 and IP69 ratings, SGS Five-Star drop-resistance certification, AI-powered software features and support for up to 24GB of combined memory through Memory Fusion technology.
title: Tecno Spark 50 Pro Unveiled With MediaTek Helio G100 Ultimate SoC, 50-Megapixel Sony Lytia 600 Camera

description: Bitcoin traded above $66,000 on Tuesday as whale accumulation, declining exchange balances, and easing geopolitical tensions supported market sentiment. Investors remained cautious ahead of the US Federal Reserve meeting, while Ethereum and other major altcoins also recorded gains alongside Bitcoin’s recovery.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $66,000 as Whale Buying, US Fed Rate Expectations Lift Sentiment

description: Telegram has been temporarily banned in India, ahead of the National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test (NEET) re-examination for the undergraduate (UG) medical aspirants, conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA), which is schedueld to take place on June 21. the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) issued directions under Section 69A of the Information Technology Act, 2000, restricting access to Telegram in India. The instant messaging platform has been banned temporarily till June 22. In a post on X, NTA welcomed MeitY’s new directions, which were issued on NTA’s recommendations.
title: MeitY Temporarily Blocks Telegram in India Ahead of NEET (UG) 2026 Re-Examination

description: Super Subbu follows a young man whose life changes dramatically after he takes up a job as a sex educator in a village.
title: Super Subbu OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Sundeep Kishan’s Comedy Series Online?

description: Electronic Arts (EA) announced the launch of EA Advertising on Monday. As per the US-based video game publisher, it is a new platform aimed at connecting brands with players through in-game experiences, live events, and digital activations across its gaming ecosystem. Brands will be allowed to integrate into gameplay through dynamic placements, branded challenges, and custom content. EA said that the platform will initially focus heavily on EA Sports franchises and live-service gaming environments.
title: Electronic Arts Unveils EA Advertising Platform to Bring Dynamic In-Game Ads Across EA Sports Titles

description: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 will be launched in India on June 25 at 12 pm IST, the tech firm announced on Tuesday. Along with the launch date, the smartphone maker has also revealed the key specifications and features of its upcoming true wireless stereo (TWS). The OnePlus Nord Buds 4 will be equipped with 12mm titanium-coated drivers. Moreover, the earphones will offer 52dB active noise cancellation (ANC) up to 5,000Hz frequency range. The company claims that each earbud will weigh about 4.3g. The upcoming in-ear OnePlus Nord Buds 4 will boast a six-microphone setup.
title: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 India Launch Date Revealed Along With Key Specifications, Features

description: Google has filed a lawsuit against Outsider Enterprise, a cybercrime network it alleges used AI-powered phishing tools to run large-scale scam campaigns through fraudulent text messages. The company said the operation was linked to more than one million malicious URLs, thousands of fake websites and hundreds of thousands of victims. Google is working with the FBI, AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon to disrupt the network. It is also backing legislation aimed at strengthening protections against AI-enabled scams and online fraud.
title: Google Partners With FBI, Carriers to Fight AI-Powered Scam Network Linked to Millions of Fraud Texts

description: Google appears to be preparing its next Pixel Drop update for Pixel smartphones. While the Mountain View-based tech giant has yet to announce its arrival, a series of promotional videos have been spotted online, offering an early glimpse at what could be coming to eligible Google Pixel smartphones. Based on the teaser videos, Google could bring several AI-powered capabilities, including a long-rumoured Screen Reactions feature and expanded Gemini Omni tools.
title: Google's Next Pixel Drop to Reportedly Bring Screen Reactions, Gemini Omni Features to Pixel Phones

description: Redmi K90 Ultra is tipped to feature Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset alongside an integrated active cooling system featuring a built-in fan. The handset is said to offer flagship-level performance and is likely to go against the handsets equipped with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. The Redmi K90 Ultra is expected to be placed just below the Redmi K90 Max, which was launched in China in April this year.
title: Redmi K90 Ultra to Launch With Snapdragon 8 Elite Chip and Built-in Cooling Fan, Tipster Claims

description: Nothing has signed memoranda of understanding with IIT Roorkee and the Foundation for Science, Innovation and Development at IISc to support deep-tech innovation, startup growth and technology design in India. Announced at Bharat Innovates 2026 in Nice, France, the partnerships will focus on mentorship, industry engagement, startup support and training opportunities. IIT Roorkee and Nothing will also explore an Industrial Design Challenge, while the IISc collaboration will support incubated startups through networking, pilot projects and potential commercial opportunities.
title: Nothing Inks MoUs With IIT Roorkee, IISc to Boost Deep-Tech Innovation in India

description: Adobe has unveiled new features for its suite of Creative Cloud products, including Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects, and Lightroom. Moreover, the company has started rolling out the Assisted Culling tool for Adobe Lightroom to a wider user base. The tool now ships with the Face View feature that is capable of isolating faces of subjects in a shot to analyse Eyes Open and Eye Sharpness to make it easier for users to evaluate images. Adobe Premiere is getting a new Global Audio Mute toggle, which allows users to mute audio across the app with a single click. Meanwhile, the new Marker Search feature will let users look for any marker by colour or name.
title: Adobe Unveils New Creative Cloud Features for Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects and Lightroom

description: Vivo X Fold 6 will be launched in China later this month, the company announced on Tuesday. In recent weeks, Vivo has been steadily revealing new details about its next-generation foldable smartphone. It is expected to arrive as the successor to the Vivo X Fold 5, which also debuted around the same time last year. Executives from the company have also shared details about the handset's display technology and imaging capabilities through a series of teasers recently.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 China Launch Date Announced as Company Reveals 'Blue Hole' Colourway

description: Redmi Turbo 5 will be launched in India at 12 pm IST today, arriving as the Xiaomi sub-brand's first Redmi Turbo series phone in the country. The Redmi Turbo 5 is confirmed to go on sale in India via Amazon. The smartphone will be offered in Black, Green, and White colour options. The tech firm has confirmed that the new smartphone will be unveiled in the country via a dedicated event. It will be powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra chipset, along with 12GB of LPDDR5x Ultra RAM, with support for up to 12GB virtual RAM expansion, and UFS 4.1 onboard storage.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 Launching Today: Know Price in India, Features, Specifications and More
